input.text:
2024年全国高中数学联赛二试A卷第4题（50分）。
原题：A、B为正整数，S是正整数的集合，满足：(1)A^k∈S对一切非负整数k；(2)若n∈S，其所有正约数均属于S；(3)若m,n∈S且gcd(m,n)=1，则mn∈S；(4)若n∈S，则An+B∈S。证明每个与B互素的正整数都属于S。
我的完整证明：
第1步。由(1)取k=0得到1∈S。我们先证明任意n∈S及任意k≥0，A^k n∈S。将n唯一拆成n=n_0 n_A，其中gcd(n_0,A)=1且n_A的每个素因子整除A；于是gcd(n_0,n_A)=1，且n_0|n，故由(2)知n_0∈S。
第2步。对给定k≥0，因n_A所有素因子都整除A，可选足够大的正整数M使A^k n_A整除A^M。由(1)(2)得A^k n_A∈S。gcd(n_0,A^k n_A)=1，由(3)得n_0(A^k n_A)=A^k n∈S。这个结论对A=1也成立（n_A=1）。
第3步。由第2步及(4)，对任意n∈S与任意k≥1，A^k n+B=A(A^(k-1)n)+B∈S。
第4步。关键引理：对任意n∈S，n+B∈S。令t=n+B，将t=t_A t_0，其中t_A由t中所有整除A的素数幂组成，gcd(t_0,A)=1，且gcd(t_A,t_0)=1。因为t_A整除某个A^M，由(1)(2)知t_A∈S。
第5步。若t_0=1则t_0=1∈S；若t_0>1，因为gcd(A,t_0)=1，欧拉定理给出某个正整数k使A^k≡1 (mod t_0)。于是A^k n+B≡n+B=t≡0 (mod t_0)。由第3步A^k n+B∈S、由(2)得t_0∈S。再由(3)与gcd(t_A,t_0)=1得n+B=t_A t_0∈S。关键引理得证。
第6步。因为1∈S，反复应用第4、5步得到1+jB∈S，对每个非负整数j成立（对j归纳）。
第7步。任取正整数n满足gcd(n,B)=1。Bezout恒等式保证存在整数x,j使nx=1+jB；通过把x,j同时按通解调整，可取x≥1且j≥0。因而nx=1+jB∈S；再由(2)及n|nx，得到n∈S。任意与B互素的正整数都属于S。证毕。

result.statement: ∀ (A B : ℕ) (S : Set ℕ), 0 < A → 0 < B → (∀ n, n ∈ S → 0 < n) → (∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k ∈ S) → (∀ n, n ∈ S → ∀ d : ℕ, d ∣ n → 0 < d → d ∈ S) → (∀ m n : ℕ, m ∈ S → n ∈ S → Nat.Coprime m n → m * n ∈ S) → (∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → A * n + B ∈ S) → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Nat.Coprime n B → n ∈ S
result.proofTerm:
by
  intro A B S hA hB hpos hpow hdiv hmul hstep n hn hcop
  have h1S : 1 ∈ S := by
    simpa using hpow 0
  have hpow_mul_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → ∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k * n ∈ S := by
    intro n hn k
    have hnpos : 0 < n := hpos n hn
    obtain ⟨n0, nA, hn_eq, hn0A, hnA_dvd⟩ := Nat.exists_coprime_mul_eq n A
    have hnA_pos : 0 < nA := by
      by_contra hnonpos
      have hnA0 : nA = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hnonpos
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        simpa [hnA0] using hn_eq
      omega
    have hn0_pos : 0 < n0 := by
      by_contra hnonpos
      have hn00 : n0 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hnonpos
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        simpa [hn00] using hn_eq
      omega
    have hn0_dvd : n0 ∣ n := by
      rw [hn_eq]
      exact dvd_mul_right n0 nA
    have hn0S : n0 ∈ S := hdiv n hn n0 hn0_dvd hn0_pos
    have hAk_nA_dvd : A ^ k * nA ∣ A ^ (n + k) := by
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hnA_dvd
      use c
      rw [pow_add, hc]
      ring
    have hAk_nA_pos : 0 < A ^ k * nA := by
      positivity
    have hAk_nA_S : A ^ k * nA ∈ S :=
      hdiv (A ^ (n + k)) (hpow (n + k)) (A ^ k * nA) hAk_nA_dvd hAk_nA_pos
    have hn0_Ak : Nat.Coprime n0 (A ^ k) := hn0A.pow_right k
    have hn0_An : Nat.Coprime n0 (A ^ n) := hn0A.pow_right n
    have hn0_nA : Nat.Coprime n0 nA := hn0_An.coprime_dvd_right hnA_dvd
    have hn0_Ak_nA : Nat.Coprime n0 (A ^ k * nA) := hn0_Ak.mul_right hn0_nA
    have hprodS : n0 * (A ^ k * nA) ∈ S :=
      hmul n0 (A ^ k * nA) hn0S hAk_nA_S hn0_Ak_nA
    have heq : n0 * (A ^ k * nA) = A ^ k * n := by
      rw [hn_eq]
      ring
    simpa [heq] using hprodS
  have hkey : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ S → n + B ∈ S := by
    intro n hn
    let t := n + B
    have hnpos : 0 < n := hpos n hn
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
      dsimp [t]
      omega
    obtain ⟨t0, tA, ht_eq, ht0A, htA_dvd⟩ := Nat.exists_coprime_mul_eq t A
    have ht0_pos : 0 < t0 := by
      by_contra hnonpos
      have ht00 : t0 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hnonpos
      have ht0 : t = 0 := by
        simpa [ht00] using ht_eq
      omega
    have htA_pos : 0 < tA := by
      by_contra hnonpos
      have htA0 : tA = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hnonpos
      have ht0 : t = 0 := by
        simpa [htA0] using ht_eq
      omega
    have htA_mem : tA ∈ S := hdiv t (hpow t) tA htA_dvd htA_pos
    have ht0_mem : t0 ∈ S := by
      by_cases h1 : t0 = 1
      · simpa [h1] using h1S
      · have hcop_A_t0 : Nat.Coprime A t0 := ht0A.symm
        obtain ⟨k, hkpos, hkmod⟩ := Nat.exists_pow_eq_one_of_coprime hcop_A_t0
        have hAk_n_B_mem : A ^ k * n + B ∈ S := by
          have hj : A ^ (k - 1) * n ∈ S := hpow_mul_mem n hn (k - 1)
          have hstepmem : A * (A ^ (k - 1) * n) + B ∈ S := hstep (A ^ (k - 1) * n) hj
          have hEqStep : A * (A ^ (k - 1) * n) + B = A ^ k * n + B := by
            have hk : k = (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
            rw [hk, pow_succ]
            ring
          simpa [hEqStep] using hstepmem
        have ht0_dvd_t : t0 ∣ t := by
          rw [ht_eq]
          exact dvd_mul_right t0 tA
        have ht0_dvd_nB : t0 ∣ n + B := by
          dsimp [t] at ht0_dvd_t
          exact ht0_dvd_t
        have hmod_mul : A ^ k * n ≡ 1 * n [MOD t0] := hkmod.mul_right n
        have hmod_add : A ^ k * n + B ≡ 1 * n + B [MOD t0] := hmod_mul.add_right B
        have hzero : 1 * n + B ≡ 0 [MOD t0] := by
          rw [Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
          simpa using ht0_dvd_nB
        have hfinal_mod : A ^ k * n + B ≡ 0 [MOD t0] := hmod_add.trans hzero
        have ht0_dvd_final : t0 ∣ A ^ k * n + B := Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp hfinal_mod
        exact hdiv (A ^ k * n + B) hAk_n_B_mem t0 ht0_dvd_final ht0_pos
    have ht0_At : Nat.Coprime t0 (A ^ t) := ht0A.pow_right t
    have hcop_t0_tA : Nat.Coprime t0 tA := ht0_At.coprime_dvd_right htA_dvd
    have hprod : t0 * tA ∈ S := hmul t0 tA ht0_mem htA_mem hcop_t0_tA
    have hEq : t0 * tA = n + B := by
      rw [← ht_eq]
      rfl
    simpa [hEq] using hprod
  have hseq : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 + j * B ∈ S := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
        simpa using h1S
    | succ j ih =>
        have h := hkey (1 + j * B) ih
        have heq : 1 + j * B + B = 1 + (j + 1) * B := by
          ring
        simpa [heq] using h
  by_cases hB1 : B = 1
  · subst B
    have hn_eq : n = 1 + (n - 1) * 1 := by omega
    have hmem : 1 + (n - 1) * 1 ∈ S := hseq (n - 1)
    simpa [hn_eq] using hmem
  · have hBgt1 : 1 < B := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, hkpos, hkmod⟩ := Nat.exists_pow_eq_one_of_coprime hcop
    let x := n ^ (k - 1)
    let j := (n ^ k) / B
    have hnx : n * x = n ^ k := by
      dsimp [x]
      have hk : k = (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hk, pow_succ]
      ring
    have hmod_eq : n ^ k % B = 1 % B := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hkmod
    have hBmod : n ^ k % B = 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hBgt1] using hmod_eq
    have hdecomp0 : n ^ k = B * (n ^ k / B) + n ^ k % B := by
      simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using (Nat.div_add_mod (n ^ k) B).symm
    have hdecomp : n ^ k = B * j + 1 := by
      dsimp [j]
      rw [hdecomp0, hBmod]
    have heq : n * x = 1 + j * B := by
      rw [hnx, hdecomp]
      ring
    have hmem1 : 1 + j * B ∈ S := hseq j
    have hmulmem : n * x ∈ S := by
      rw [heq]
      exact hmem1
    exact hdiv (n * x) hmulmem n (dvd_mul_right n x) hn
